description: The Mopo project deposits simulated hourly solar photovoltaic and wind generation time series for pan-European energy planning. Its Zenodo page also identifies variable-renewable-energy costs, greenfield potential and installed capacities for 2020 and 2025, with time series in GMT. The release covers three PV types, existing and four offshore-wind designs, and existing and nine onshore-wind designs. Zenodo lists a public 1.56 GB ZIP under CC BY 4.0. These series could drive capacity-expansion or electricity-dispatch simulations across countries and regions. They are modelled resource profiles, not direct metered output; the linked methodology uses ERA5 and Global Wind Atlas inputs with separate provenance. The ZIP is large and was not downloaded, so regional codes, file counts, time coverage and the internal Maps and info documentation remain unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this specific VRE package; a broader Mopo planning dataset in the catalogue is not proof that its files contain this complete release.
